skill_name: Collect information about the planet Mars.
workflow: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Also known as the "Red Planet," it has long been associated with war and has inspired many science fiction stories. Mars is the only planet besides Earth to have evidence of liquid water on its surface in the form of ice and running water. It has two moons, Phobos and Deimos, which were discovered in 1877.
